title: チワワの花すけ～お花見 (Chihuahua Hanasuke: Cherry Blossom Viewing)
description: 春です。桜が咲きました。花すけはおねえさんと目黒川へお花見に行きます。Spring has come and Hanasuke goes cherry blossom viewing at Meguro River with his big sister. Includes Japanese cultural notes on hanami. Tadoku Level 0.
author: 丸山京子 (Maruyama Kyōko), NPO多言語多読
